description: Eval billed-not-delivered: plan account -> invoices -> tracking, compare billed vs delivered, cite the billing dispute policy.

responses.reasoning: Need the account id, its open invoices and the proof of delivery.

responses.goal: Compare what Pinecrest was billed for SO-104301 with what was delivered

responses.answer: Pinecrest Hardware was invoiced $3,036.00 on INV-90377 for all of SO-104301, but proof of delivery for SHP-55107 shows only 5 of 10 cartons received on 2026-11-03. Per the billing dispute policy, open a case with reason "billed not delivered"; AR will hold dunning on INV-90377 for 15 days [customer-service-policy.md#0]. Opening the case needs a CS lead's approval.
